headline: Marathon Petroleum Beats Quarterly Estimates and Agrees to Sell Refineries to CVR Energy
summary: Marathon surpassed quarterly profit estimates and announced an agreement to sell two of its refineries to CVR Energy.
why: Marathon Petroleum is a major independent petroleum product refiner, marketer, and transporter in the United States, and asset divestitures directly impact its operational footprint and capital allocation.

impacts.name: Marathon Petroleum
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected quarterly results typically drive positive equity momentum for the reporting company.
